desc:
💜 Dan’s Karaoke is a ROBLOX voice chat experience where you sing your heart out and challenge other players on karaoke machines all across the map! Listen, perform, and meet amazing singers!

🌍 20,000+ FREE songs uploaded by the community in English, Japanese, Chinese, Korean, Spanish, Filipino, Indonesian, Thai & more.

🥇 Spotlight Karaoke: Takes turns singing center stage in front of the crowd!

🎮 Together Karaoke: Everyone sings it out together in one spot!
